question: A man spent 30% of his monthly income on rent. He spent 15% of the remaining amount on food. 35% of the amount now left was used for all other expenses. If Rs. 1,62,435 was left with him, then his monthly income was:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the **Successive Remainder** method:

Initial Income × (100 − 30)/100 × (100 − 15)/100 × (100 − 35)/100 = 1,62,435

Income × 0.70 × 0.85 × 0.65 = 1,62,435

Income × 0.38675 = 1,62,435

Income = 1,62,435 ÷ 0.38675 = 4,20,000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 4,20,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Rent** = 30%, **Food** = 15% of remaining, **Other expenses** = 35% of remaining, **Final savings** = Rs. 1,62,435.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d0571c2a16013a1eae6b48b58a79dcb98c578eaa7f1af28e36cccd10051b646.png] 

⇒ Let the **Monthly Income** be 'x'.

⇒ Amount left after **Rent** = x − 30% of x = 0.70x

⇒ Amount left after **Food** = 0.70x × (100 − 15)% = 0.70x × 0.85 = 0.595x

⇒ Amount left after **Other expenses** = 0.595x × (100 − 35)% = 0.595x × 0.65

⇒ 0.38675x = 1,62,435

⇒ x = 1,62,435 ÷ 0.38675

⇒ x = 4,20,000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 4,20,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

When values change on the **remaining balance**, we use the formula: Final = Initial × (1 ± r₁/100) × (1 ± r₂/100) × ...

Percentage to Fraction Conversion

Simplifying 30% = 3/10, 15% = 3/20, and 35% = 7/20 can make manual calculations faster by using **ratio units**.

Base Change Rule

Always identify the **base** of the percentage. If it's of the 'total', add percentages directly; if it's of the 'remaining', multiply them successively.</p
